sketch.alt: ZIMA-CAD Sketcher displaying a circle with a 9 mm radius dimension, the geometry tree, view controls, and OK and Cancel actions.

markers.title: Circle and centre
markers.body: The white circle is the sketch curve. Its white centre point is separate from the brown sketch origin at the lower left.

markers.title: Edit the radius
markers.body: Double-click the displayed R9mm dimension to open its value editor. The same radius dimension is listed under Kóty in the tree.

markers.title: Look normal to the sketch
markers.body: Click Pohled kolmo to face the active sketch plane. The adjacent Převrátit and Otočit controls change the viewing orientation.

markers.title: Finish the edit
markers.body: Click OK to keep the sketch edits. Zrušit directly below it closes the editing session without keeping its pending changes.

feature.alt: ZIMA-CAD Feature Properties dialog configured for Extrusion, with placement references, an XY sketch plane, the Sketch button, Add and Cut, and OK and Cancel.

markers.title: Place the feature
markers.body: Click the reference field to arm geometry selection. The eye in the same row is a separate inspection control. This capture has no placement reference entered.

markers.title: Define the profile
markers.body: Click Skica to edit the feature profile. XY is currently selected in the plane controls to the left; the plane offset reads 0,000 mm.

markers.title: Choose the material operation
markers.body: Přičíst selects Add and Odečíst selects Cut. Add is selected in this capture, with Těleso chosen as the result type.

markers.title: Confirm the complete definition
markers.body: After defining the profile and limits, click OK to validate and calculate the feature. Zrušit discards the pending dialog changes. The capture shows the initial dialog, not a completed solid.

fillet-chamfer.alt: ZIMA-CAD solid Fillet Properties with a 1 mm constant radius, three selected edge references, and their cyan wire feedback on a machined part.

markers.title: Set the radius
markers.body: Edit Poloměr R to set the fillet radius. The displayed definition uses the Konstantní type and a radius of 1,000 mm.

markers.title: Add an edge reference
markers.body: Click Vybrat referenci, then select an input edge in the view. Three references are already listed; each red cross removes its corresponding list item.

markers.title: Check the selected edges
markers.body: Cyan wire feedback identifies the selected edges on the real input part. The dialog is still open, so this view must not be read as the committed final fillet result.

markers.title: Calculate and confirm
markers.body: Click OK to calculate and confirm the pending fillet. Zrušit closes the dialog without committing its edits. The neighbouring Sražení command is visible in the modeling toolbar below.

sheet-metal.alt: ZIMA-CAD Sheet Metal workspace showing a sheet with a formed ventilation opening, its Body history, and the sheet-metal command toolbar.

markers.title: Open Sheet Metal tools
markers.body: Click Plechy to show the sheet-metal command set. It is selected in this capture; the right-hand toolbar contains Tabule, Ohyb, Profil and Tváření.

markers.title: Read the Body history
markers.body: The green Sheet row identifies the active Body. Its tree contains Skica and Tváření 01, corresponding to the formed opening visible in the sheet.

markers.title: Inspect the formed geometry
markers.body: The narrow raised opening is the calculated forming result. The brown planes and coloured axes around it belong to the displayed Body origin.

markers.title: Find the unfolding controls
markers.body: Rozvinout is the unfold command. Ohnout zpět is directly below it, followed by DXF export. This capture shows the folded model, not an exported flat pattern.

fem.alt: ZIMA-CAD FEM workspace displaying a meshed three-arm bracket, a 1000 N force, two restraints, and a von Mises stress colour scale in MPa.

markers.title: Read the analysis definition
markers.body: FEM těleso 1 is the active analysis Body. Its tree lists the source Body, two restraints named Vazba 1 and Vazba 2, and the force Síla 1.

markers.title: Check loads and restraints
markers.body: The yellow annotation on the left arm reads Síla 1 = 1000 N. The other yellow annotations mark the two restrained regions. These symbols describe this example's boundary conditions.

markers.title: Read the result scale
markers.body: The legend is labelled Napětí von Mises [MPa]. Blue represents the lower end and red the upper end of this result scale, whose displayed maximum is 49,54 MPa.

markers.title: Choose a result display
markers.body: Click Výsledky to access result display choices. Zobrazit deformaci immediately above controls the deformation view; the bottom-left annotation shows a scale factor of ×1 in this capture.

cam.alt: ZIMA-CAD Generic NC program inspector with a selected linear motion, motion stepping controls, stock-result toggle, and the corresponding tool position over a workpiece.

markers.title: Select a motion
markers.body: Click a motion row to show its tool position. Row 8, LINEAR X0 Y-2 Z2, is selected here. The header identifies this as generic NC that requires controller postprocessing.

markers.title: Step through the program
markers.body: Click Další pohyb for the next motion or Předchozí pohyb for the previous one. The slider to their right moves through the same calculated sequence.

markers.title: Show calculated remaining stock
markers.body: Toggle Zobrazit vypočtený zbytek polotovaru to inspect the calculated remaining stock. The box is unchecked in this screenshot.

markers.title: Relate the program to the view
markers.body: The model view places the displayed tool over the workpiece at the selected program motion. Keep this view and the selected NC row together when checking the path.

getting-started.alt: ZIMA-CAD New Document dialog with the Part document type selected, the name reference, the Skeleton environment, and OK and Cancel.

markers.title: Name the document
markers.body: Enter the document name in Název souboru. The example currently reads reference; this is the user-defined name, not a command.

markers.title: Choose a Part
markers.body: Select Díl for a Part document. Sestava creates an Assembly and Výkres creates a Drawing; their radio buttons are below.

markers.title: Select the Part environment
markers.body: Open the selector beside Díl to choose the required Part environment. Skeleton is selected in this capture, so check this field before confirming an ordinary modeling Part.

markers.title: Create the selected document
markers.body: Click OK after checking the name, document type and environment. This screenshot shows the creation dialog before a document has been created.

sweep.alt: ZIMA-CAD initial 2D Sweep Properties dialog with XY selected, the Path Sketch button, two profile stations and empty placement references.

markers.title: Choose the path plane
markers.body: Click XY, XZ or YZ to choose the container plane for the path sketch. XY is selected in this capture.

markers.title: Define the path sketch
markers.body: Click Skica dráhy... to edit the sweep path. The placement reference table above is empty in this initial definition.

markers.title: Define station profiles
markers.body: Click Skica in the station row to edit its profile. The first row is 1 — začátek and the second is 1 — konec. Both currently request the first profile with Vyplňte první profil.

markers.title: Confirm a complete sweep
markers.body: After defining the path and required profiles, click OK to validate and calculate the sweep. Zrušit discards pending changes. This capture shows setup controls, not a calculated sweep result.

assembly.alt: ZIMA-CAD Component Properties in an Assembly, showing a source Part, three paired origin planes at zero offset, independent inspection eyes and zero remaining degrees of freedom.

markers.title: Check the source Part
markers.body: The Zdroj field identifies component-reference.prtz as this occurrence’s source. The Assembly tree contains two occurrences of that Part.

markers.title: Read the placement pairs
markers.body: The Tento díl and Cíl columns pair the component and target references. XY, YZ and XZ are paired here, each with the Plocha type and a 0,000 mm offset.

markers.title: Inspect each reference independently
markers.body: Click the eye under Zobrazit díl to inspect the component reference, or the neighbouring eye under Zobrazit cíl to inspect the target reference.

markers.title: Check the remaining freedom
markers.body: Zbývající stupně volnosti: 0 reports no remaining degrees of freedom for these three plane pairs. Click OK at the lower right to confirm the pending placement; Zrušit discards its changes.

drawings.alt: ZIMA-CAD Drawing View Properties showing the source model, view label rows, custom orientation, visible-edge mode, scale 0.500 and sheet position.

markers.title: Choose the source model
markers.body: Open Zdroj to select the view source, or click Soubor to choose a file. The current source is Drawing source — Výchozí (nativní).

markers.title: Set the projection orientation
markers.body: Open Základní pohled to choose a base view. Vlastní orientace is selected here, with horizontal 17°, vertical −23° and in-plane 31° angles in the fields below.

markers.title: Set the drawing scale
markers.body: The Měřítko selector is Vlastní and Hodnota is 0,500, corresponding to the M1:2 label above. The X and Y fields below position the view on the sheet in millimetres.

markers.title: Confirm the view properties
markers.body: Click OK to confirm the view settings or Zrušit to discard pending changes. This capture shows the view definition dialog; the projected sheet geometry is outside the screenshot.

render.alt: ZIMA-CAD spotlight Properties in a Render Body, showing the selected light in the tree, placement controls, white colour, 1000 lm luminous flux and a 45-degree cone with its scene glyph.

markers.title: Identify the scene light
markers.body: Reflektor 1 is selected under Render těleso 1. The same Render Body also contains Kamera 1 and Slunce 1; the open dialog edits the spotlight.

markers.title: Set colour and luminous flux
markers.body: Edit Barva (#RRGGBB) for the light colour and Světelný tok for luminous flux. This example uses #ffffff and 1000 lm, with Světlo zapnuto checked.

markers.title: Set the spotlight cone
markers.body: Edit Úhel kuželu to change the cone angle; it reads 45° here. Poloměr světla is 5 mm and Měkkost okraje is 0,25 in the neighbouring fields.

markers.title: Relate the light to the scene
markers.body: The cyan cone in the model view is the spotlight glyph. Zobrazit značku v pohledu is checked in the dialog. Click OK at the bottom right to confirm the pending light settings.
